title_sq: SHESIM AMBIENT ZYRASH NË RRUGËN NDRE MJEDA!
description_sq:
Prona pozicionohet me fasade ne Rrugen Ndre Mjeda. Ndodhet me katin e pare te nje pallati me hyrje te vecuar, dedikuar zyrave. 
Zyrat ofrohen me nje mobilim modern dhe nje investim si : 
-sistem chiller ngrohje/ftohje + aspirim 
-sistem sigurie alarmi dhe zjarri
-sistem kamerash + dhomen e serverit 
Njesia disponon nje siperfaqe neto prej 250.5m2 me certifikate pronesie . 
Aktualisht zyrat jane ne funksion dhe kane hapesira pune te konsiderueshme si : 
- Recepsion + koridor shperndares

- 6 ambiente pune te ndara

- 2 tualete 
- 1 dhome serverash \
Ambienti eshte i pershtatshem per tipologji biznesi te ndryshme si zyra arkitektuare, klinik dentare, zyra programimi , fizioterapie, etj.
Per me shume informacion na kontaktoni !
title_en: SALE OF OFFICES ON THE STREET INTERMEDIATE!
description_en: The property is positioned with a facade on Ndre Mjeda Street. It is located on the first floor of a building with a separate entrance, dedicated to offices. The offices are offered with modern furniture and an investment such as: - heating/cooling chiller system + aspiration - alarm and fire security system - camera system + server room The unit has a net surface of 250.5m2 with ownership certificates. Currently, the offices are in operation and have significant work spaces such as: - Reception + distribution corridor - 1 meeting room - 6 separate work areas - 1 dining area - 2 toilets - 1 server room \ The environment is suitable for different types of business such as architectural offices, dental clinics, programming offices, physiotherapy, etc. For more information contact us!
